bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
test "$(realpath "$root")" = /home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot || exit 70
stage="$root/.worktrees/gaybbs-common-review-0145893"
test "$(git -C "$stage" rev-parse HEAD)" = 01458932044017067ae14a6e01639d28a90cc948 || exit 71
docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:shared-0145893 >/dev/null || exit 72
old="$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=gaybbs --format '{{.ID}}')"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$old" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 73
proj="$(docker inspect --format '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project"}}' "$old")"
test -n "$proj" && test "$proj" != "<no value>" || exit 74
oldimage="$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' "$old")"
docker image inspect "$oldimage" >/dev/null || exit 75
docker tag "$oldimage" gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:pre-common-20261119 || exit 76
(cd "$root/deploy" && docker compose -p "$proj" -f gserver-compose.yaml config -q) || exit 77
docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:shared-0145893 gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local || exit 78
if ! docker compose -p "$proj" -f "$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs; then
 docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:pre-common-20261119 gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
 docker compose -p "$proj" -f "$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs || true
 exit 79
fi
now="$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=gaybbs --filter label=com.docker.compose.project="$proj" --format '{{.ID}}')"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$now" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 80
for i in $(seq 1 30); do docker logs "$now" 2>&1 | grep -q 'GAYBBS_BOT_READY' && break; sleep 1; done
docker logs "$now" 2>&1 | grep -q 'GAYBBS_BOT_READY' || exit 81
db="$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.project="$proj" --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=postgres --format '{{.ID}}')"
test -n "$db" || exit 82
col="$(docker exec "$db" psql -U gace -d gaybbs -tA -c "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='gate_sessions' AND column_name='requested_talk_index';")" || exit 83
test "$col" = 1 || exit 84
systemctl --user is-active --quiet gace-userbot-verify.service || exit 85
echo GAYBBS_COMMON_LIVE_RUNTIME_PASS
